pairs.evidence: src/lib/prompt-context.ts:22 The shared project header drops the scanned-state section whenever no scan object is passed, which is the case the standard says the producer reads as unknown territory and then invents into.

techniques.evidence: src/lib/prompt-context.ts:428 PromptBuilder.build does push context, quality pack, domain, task, spec, wiring, best practices, output schema, then criteria, and throws if context or task is missing. Known UE pitfalls are still concatenated into that header, so they are read before the task.

src/lib/prompt-context.ts:22 When a DynamicProjectContext is passed, classes are grouped and counted, an empty class list is explicit, and the do-not-recreate sentence is included. A missing scan omits the section; scannedAt is never rendered; plugins and deps say nothing when empty; there is no item cap.

src/lib/prompts/prompt-builder.ts:159 The shared renderer can list moduleAssets and returns '' when both lists are empty (the comment above this line, which says an empty array still emits the four sub-prompts, is stale). The builder never forwards moduleAssets, and buildMaterialConfiguratorPrompt never calls withWiringRequirements, while MODULE_WIRING_ASSETS.materials names M_Master. cli-task-handlers.ts:781 dispatches that prompt with no wiring block.

src/lib/prompts/prompt-builder.ts:222 addSuccessCriteria rebuilds the section by parsing the already-rendered numbered list, which the technique names as the fragile form. withSuccessCriteria remains the replacing setter. No cap or elision count is applied.

src/lib/prompts/animation-checklist.ts:88 Domain framings and the MSVC floor are read from getEngineFacts(ctx.ueVersion). This best-practices block still types a 5.7 API fact into the prompt. The heading above it only marks the block as verified on 5.7.

src/lib/prompt-context.ts:279 formatGotchas keeps untagged gotchas, intersects module domains, and leaves an unknown module on the superset; an explicit empty domain list (for example arpg-loot) stays truthy and keeps only universals. animation-checklist and material-configurator spread moduleKnowledge(), one object for kind, module, and known assets. Nothing counts how often the superset fallback is taken.

src/lib/prompts/animation-checklist.ts:51 These builders author classes and materials inside an existing UE module. A repo search for focus-loss, quit-from-program, and shell-convention wording found no shell inventory. The technique says that case uses the wiring section.

pairs.registryProposal: Measure the fallback rate never says where the count has to live or what increment makes a router conformant, so a three-tier router with no counter can be read either as conformant or as the hidden-fallback failure.
